name: Shared with you
title: Shared with you: a Google Doc somebody shared with you, in the morning brief, with the task it belongs to and Add to the task

events.added: You pressed Add to task on a document the morning brief said was shared with you
events.opened: You opened a document the morning brief said was shared with you
events.seen: You pressed Got it on a document the morning brief said was shared with you

runs.shown: Rouh put a document shared with you in the morning brief

permissions: reads Google's "Document shared with you" emails of the last two weeks in your own inboxes, read only
reads your tasks' notes (.md files) to find which task names the person who shared it
asks Rouh's own Google Drive whether it can open each document
writes the document's link into the task's AGENTS.md when you press Add to task
touches.remove: Turn the switch shared_with_you off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone; to remove it for good revert night 23's commit (rouh/shared_with_you.py, the brief_shared_with_you route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawShared and its helpers in briefpage.js and the .bf-shared rules in briefpage.css, this manifest) and delete the user setting shared_with_you. Lines it added under "Documents added" in a task's AGENTS.md stay, as the task's own notes.
